**Test Automation at Scale**

Quality is built in, not inspected in. For a Scandinavian media group, our QA practice achieved 87% automated test coverage across the core digital platform within 6 months of engagement — a level that enabled the client to cut production incidents by 62% year-on-year.

**Performance and Load Testing**

We test for realistic peak loads, not laboratory conditions. For the same media group's streaming platform, we executed k6 load tests simulating 25,000 concurrent users. The test surfaced a 340ms routing bottleneck in the CDN layer that, had it reached peak season, would have degraded the experience for millions of viewers. The issue was eliminated pre-launch.

**Quality Gates in Every Sprint**

Our delivery model embeds quality gates at every sprint boundary: automated regression, exploratory testing, and performance benchmarking against baseline. Release to production requires all gates to be green — no exceptions.
